The Challenge

Sky Gazer has become a cult classic amongst beachgoers across the country. Pepper was lucky to work with this Sunshine Coast-based family business specialising in sand-resistant beach towels. We captured the essence of their brand and helped transform their product.

During an initial catch-up with our crew, Sky Gazer briefed us on the concept, theme and ultimate inspo they were going for. So we got to work putting together a shot list, booking a studio to use our camera-quality lighting, sourcing models and determining on-site locations for the beach vibe they wanted.

How We Helped.

We planned everything to a tee but also left room for those candid moments and shots every photographer strives for. When D-Day came, we had everything ready to go – we even had the help of a furry friend. Things went so smoothly, and Sky Gazer had so much confidence they were happy to let us run the show whilst they continued to work. We captured enough content to last them for months. We’re talking collateral that could be used across their website, socials, ads and all sorts of marketing material. We pulled this off with:

From the shoot.

The Outcome

Our mates over at Chilli Group marketing gave us a hand planning out what assets needed to be created for Sky Gazer’s website product imagery update and ad campaign. Since working with our team, SkyGazer has quickly become synonymous with beach towels. Their presence on the Sunshine Coast has grown dramatically, and their social following continues to rise. Ultimately, the product images in their ads and on their website continue to generate leads and increase conversions. We’re so stoked for them and love watching them grow!
